seo.title: Astra — Websites with an aftereffect
seo.description: Astra is an independent website design and development studio. Distinctive business websites, e-commerce and web applications, built to turn attention into action.

projects.title: Forma Audio
projects.description: A considered shopping experience for a new generation of sound. Product storytelling meets a remarkably simple path to purchase.
projects.headline: Sound you can almost feel.
projects.imageAlt: Brushed aluminum headphones with terracotta ear cushions on a mineral-grey studio surface
projects.challenge: How do you communicate the character of a premium audio product before a visitor can hear it? We explored a product-led website that gives material, detail and listening experience equal weight.
projects.approach: We designed an editorial product journey with oversized photography, clear product information and a focused purchase path. A restrained visual system gives the product room to breathe while keeping shopping controls familiar.
projects.outcome: An original website direction demonstrating how brand expression and e-commerce usability can work together. This is self-initiated concept work, not a commissioned client launch; no sales or conversion results are claimed.

projects.title: Monument
projects.description: An architectural practice, translated into a digital space. A project archive with the same confidence as the buildings it presents.
projects.headline: Space, made digital.
projects.imageAlt: Monumental concrete architecture with a warm vertical aperture against a blue-grey dusk sky
projects.challenge: Architecture portfolios often make visitors choose between beautiful imagery and useful project information. This exploration treats navigation, context and visual impact as parts of the same experience.
projects.approach: A generous editorial layout pairs immersive project imagery with concise location, discipline and project information. Clear navigation makes the archive browsable on a phone without reducing it to a list of thumbnails.
projects.outcome: A complete visual and content direction for an architecture website. The case study is an independent concept, supported by original generated architectural imagery rather than an actual client building or endorsement.

projects.title: Relay
projects.description: Less noise. More control. An operations dashboard that helps a small team see what needs to happen next.
projects.headline: Clarity is a feature.
projects.challenge: Small teams need a shared picture of their work without another complicated system to maintain. We explored a browser-based workspace that turns operational data into useful next steps.
projects.approach: We grouped information around decisions: what is active, what is blocked and what is ready. A clear hierarchy, accessible status labels and restrained data visualization keep the workspace scannable.
projects.outcome: An interface concept for a custom web application. The sample data illustrates the design and does not represent real clients or business results. Production integrations would be scoped for the individual business.
